svg.title: Boundary mapping — coordinates, ownership and destination — decoder_upsample_c1024_to_c512_fp16
svg.desc: Direction-specific spatial boundary. Every highlighted pixel and lane has an explicit coordinate; the two layouts use different address formulas. Residual-only views are distinguished from main-input gathers.
svg.text: Boundary mapping — coordinates, ownership and destination
Project each low token once: 1024→512 with 4 K256 splits.
The register shuffle/repetition broadcasts that low result into four distinct high token destinations.
Each high destination reads its own saved skip. Those four residual vectors are not copies of each other.
Crop to the actual high field; at the C1024→C512 4K transition, repeated height 72 is clipped to 68.
Grid labels are actual pixel (x,y) coordinates relative to the selected window. Orange shows one complete spatial dependency.
